book.environment: .NET 10; xUnit. Each UTC calls the production function directly (in-process) with the listed inputs; no browser, no HTTP. Round 1 starts as Pending; only a real execution sets Passed or Failed.
book.note: Statuses: Passed, Failed, Pending, N/A. Round 1 starts as Pending; only a real execution sets Passed or Failed. One sheet per production function (Class.Method shortened to <=31 chars); the group row holds the full Class.Method. UTC numbering restarts per sheet.
book.title: UNIT TEST DOCUMENT

changes.description: Rebuilt as a JSON pipeline like 5.2/5.2.2: one sheet per production function, UTC rows, from unit/*.json

sheets.description: Password sign-in decision: valid credentials vs unknown email vs wrong password vs deactivated account.

methods.decides: Returns success with token pair and capabilities, or InvalidCredentials (MSG01) vs AccountDeactivated (MSG02); unknown email costs one password verification and is indistinguishable from a wrong password.

sheets.precondition: Seeded users exist (active, deactivated); password hasher configured.

sheets.description: Password hashing and verification: same password verifies, different password fails, malformed hash fails instead of throwing.

methods.decides: Hash creates a salted hash; Verify returns true only for the matching password (incl. rehash-needed); malformed or placeholder hash returns false, never throws.
Creates a salted hash with a fresh random salt on every call; the same password never produces the same hash text.

sheets.precondition: No database needed; pure hashing check.

sheets.description: Access token contents and lifetime: subject, capability claims, expiry, tamper rejection.

methods.decides: Creates a signed JWT with sub, jti, email, name and one cap claim per capability; expires after the configured lifetime; tampered or wrong-key tokens are rejected by the validator.

sheets.precondition: Signing key configured; test user with known capabilities.

sheets.description: User creation rules: valid input creates an active account; validation, duplicate email and unknown role are refused.

methods.decides: Valid input stores an active account with a hashed password and audits; invalid fields are reported together; duplicate email answers MSG08; unknown role answers MSG09.

sheets.precondition: Admin actor with user-management capability; roles seeded.

sheets.description: Deactivate and reactivate rules: status change, last-admin guard, session and Voice ID side effects.

methods.decides: Deactivate/reactivate flips status and audits; self-target, no-op and last-admin deactivation are refused; deactivation ends sessions and the Voice ID inside the same write.

sheets.precondition: At least two active administrators exist for the guard cases.

sheets.description: Capability matrix update: grant/revoke capabilities with the lock-out guard.

methods.decides: Saves the requested capabilities, deduped and sorted; refuses an unknown capability (MSG17) and removing AdminUsers from the last role holding it; identical sets write nothing.

sheets.precondition: Roles seeded; admin actor holds role management capability.

sheets.description: Custom role creation: name and capability validation, duplicate guard, built-in protection.

methods.decides: Valid input creates a custom role; blank or over-long names, unknown capabilities and duplicate names (MSG20/MSG21) are refused; built-in roles are never created this way.

sheets.precondition: Capability catalogue available; no role with the test name exists.

sheets.description: Meeting workflow transitions: submit, approve, reject, publish, cancel and organizer transfer with guards.

methods.decides: Each legal edge changes status, writes history and notifies; wrong actor, lost capability, self-approval, ineligible approver, unready roster and stale state are refused with 404/403/409/400 and the matching MSGnn.

sheets.precondition: Meeting in the required start status with a valid roster; actor with the required capability.

sheets.description: Meeting start and end: chair-only transitions with roster checks and fan-out on end.

methods.decides: Chair starts a Published meeting and ends a running one; non-chair, wrong status and broken roster are refused; end fans out to agenda, speaking, vote drafts and room closure.
methods.gap: Partial direct coverage (invalid-command rejection and cancellation-after-commit); roster and auth branches are HTTP-only.

sheets.precondition: Published meeting with one chair and at least one secretary for Start; InProgress meeting for End.

sheets.description: Meeting create and update validation: title, mode, timestamps and the Published reschedule lock.

methods.decides: Valid input creates or updates the meeting; blank title, bad enum, end before start and locked-field changes on a Published meeting are refused with field errors.

sheets.precondition: Organizer with meeting-creation capability; valid timestamps with offsets.

sheets.description: Overrun detection: a running meeting left past its planned end is auto-ended by the worker.

methods.decides: Returns true when status is InProgress and the planned end (or actual start) is at or before the cutoff; otherwise false; the worker then writes the AutoEnd history row.
methods.gap: No direct truth-table test; covered only transitively via MeetingTestDoubles and worker HTTP tests.

sheets.precondition: Meeting with known status, planned end and actual start; cutoff is now minus grace.

sheets.description: Meeting read policy: who may read a meeting, its history and its rejection reason.

methods.decides: Creator, assigned approver and current participants by status may read; outsiders and cancelled-from-Draft meetings get 404; rejection reason is visible only to its audience.

sheets.precondition: Meeting with known creator, approver and participant list.

sheets.description: Agenda item validation: title, description, presenter and document links.

methods.decides: Valid input normalizes newlines and passes; blank or over-long titles, bad presenter assignments and duplicate document links return field errors.
methods.gap: Direct coverage is Validate/Normalize only; the action matrix (Actions/CanRecordConclusion) is HTTP-only.

sheets.precondition: Meeting exists; presenter is a participant of the meeting.

sheets.description: Invitation response rule: who may answer, once, and when the answer is final.

methods.decides: Active non-chair participants with a Pending response in a Published or InProgress meeting may answer once; chair answers, second answers and wrong statuses are refused.
methods.gap: No ParticipantRulesTests file; covered only via HTTP endpoint tests.

sheets.precondition: Participant row with known role, status and response; meeting in Published or InProgress.

sheets.description: Attendance save: secretary-only write with optimistic concurrency and totals on read.

methods.decides: Secretary saves the attendance list for an InProgress meeting; non-secretary, wrong status, stale version token and unknown targets are refused; read returns totals and permissions.
methods.gap: No direct service test; all coverage is HTTP/SignalR (AttendanceEndpointTests). Needs direct tests.

sheets.precondition: InProgress meeting; actor is an active secretary; current version token known.

sheets.description: Meeting document upload gate: access, file count, sizes, type agreement and hostile content.

methods.decides: Valid PDF/DOCX files pass with SHA-256 and page counts; access, file count, total and per-file sizes, type mismatches and hostile PDFs are refused per file with an index.

sheets.precondition: Active user who may read the meeting; candidate files with names and bytes.

sheets.description: Online room status: whether the call room is open for a meeting status and mode.

methods.decides: Maps meeting status and mode to room status (open, not-started, ended, in-person-only, cancelled); join and mute follow the same rule.

sheets.precondition: Meeting with known status and mode.

sheets.description: Microphone-bleed fold: leaked speech sentences are attributed to the louder speaker.

methods.decides: A segment covered by another speaker (60 percent within 2s lag, 50 percent word containment, 6 dB louder) is marked as a leak of that speaker; own loud voice is kept.

sheets.precondition: Speech clips with words, timings and peak levels; shared fold cases available.

sheets.description: Speaker suggestion: which user each diarized voice belongs to, with margin and split-person checks.

methods.decides: Best-sample cosine over the threshold with a sufficient margin suggests the user; near-ties are refused; a second voice of the same person is suggested twice only with evidence.

sheets.precondition: Diarized speakers with embeddings and candidate users with voice samples; threshold and margin configured.

sheets.description: Transcript-to-take fit: each segment snaps to the take holding most of it.

methods.decides: Returns the fitted start and end inside the take with the largest overlap; ties go to the later take; null or single takes pass through.

sheets.precondition: Transcript segment with start and end; recording takes with known ranges.

sheets.description: Vote draft validation: question, options, eligibility roles and anonymity flag.

methods.decides: A draft with 2 distinct options and at least one eligible role passes; empty titles, over-long text, duplicate options and bad role strings return field errors keyed by field.
methods.gap: No direct test; covered only via HTTP (VoteEndpointTests). Needs direct validation tests.

sheets.precondition: Draft input with title, options and eligible roles.

sheets.description: Eligible voter freeze: who may vote is fixed when the vote opens.

methods.decides: Returns the distinct ordered ids of active users holding the selected roles who may read the meeting; attendance is ignored and Guests are excluded; empty means the vote cannot open.
methods.gap: No direct test; covered only via HTTP opening tests.

sheets.precondition: Meeting with participants and roles; selected eligible roles.

sheets.description: Vote percentage display: per-option share rounded away from zero to 2 decimals, and the zero-ballot case.

methods.decides: Returns the rounded percentage (away from zero, 2 decimals) or null when no ballots exist; 0 votes and unanimous votes are Boundary cases.
methods.gap: No direct test; covered only implicitly via HTTP result tests.

sheets.precondition: Ballot count and per-option counts.

sheets.description: Fixed minutes template: renders sections I-III from the reviewed draft or from agenda, conclusions, votes and notes.

methods.decides: Draft present renders its sections; otherwise agenda plus recorded conclusions, votes and secretary notes render with blank placeholders; hostile AI text stays a plain line and pipes are neutralized.

sheets.precondition: Minutes records with agenda, people, conclusions, votes and notes; optional reviewed draft.

sheets.description: Minutes HTML sanitizer: allow-listed tags and styles, depth guard and empty-document detection.

methods.decides: Allowed tags and styles pass and the result is idempotent; script, iframe, images and over-deep trees fall back to text; empty documents are refused by SaveAsync.

sheets.precondition: HTML fragment from the editor; allow-list and depth limit configured.

sheets.description: Starting-soon reminders: one notification per active participant inside the 15-minute window.

methods.decides: Queues one reminder row per active participant of Published meetings in the window; existing keys are skipped so a reschedule creates a new key; returns the created count.

sheets.precondition: Published meetings starting within 15 minutes with active participants.

sheets.description: Email queue worker: claim the oldest message, send it, retry with backoff or fail permanently.

methods.decides: Sends the claimed message; 400/422 and undeliverable domains fail at once while 429/5xx retry with exponential backoff; expired leases are reclaimed and shutdown cancels without marking.

sheets.precondition: Queued email rows with attempts below the maximum; provider reachable.

sheets.description: Report period parsing: trailing 12 months by default, explicit yyyy-MM ranges up to 24 months.

methods.decides: Both missing means the trailing 12 months; otherwise two yyyy-MM values forming a 1-24 month range within years 2000-9998; anything else returns null and the endpoint answers 400.
methods.gap: No direct Parse test; covered only via HTTP report tests.

sheets.precondition: Optional from and to strings; current time for the default window.

sheets.description: Meeting time search: candidate slots on the work grid with busy and unknown marking.

methods.decides: Walks the step grid inside working hours minus lunch, skips the past, expands busy periods by the buffer and returns all-free or most-free slots capped at 200 with truncation flags.

sheets.precondition: Slot search with invitees, duration, range and working hours; each person with busy windows.

sheets.description: Calendar share state machine: who may request, share, respond, change, withdraw and end; direct unit tests cover the action table.

methods.decides: Pending and Effective shares expose different actions to owner and viewer; accept with a pending change, sensitivity coverage (never Secret) and lapse rules gate each action.

sheets.precondition: Calendar share with known state, owner, viewer and sensitivity level.
